Realism of metal reflections and shadows

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points between the gold locket and the chain. AI often fails here, creating fused or floating connections. Also, inspect the small dangling charms on the right for logical physical attachment.
image_description: A close-up studio shot of an ornate, vintage-style necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a central gold-toned heart-shaped locket pendant with an engraved floral or figure design. The chain consists of elaborate metalwork segments containing pink oval cabochon stones and clear faceted beads, connected by smaller metallic links. Small dangling charms are visible on the right side.
